caption: The drawing depicts a wooden table with four slender, tapered legs and a rectangular top with rounded edges. The table is primarily rendered in shades of brown, with darker brown used for the top, front panel, and parts of the legs, and lighter brown or tan accents along the edges and on the legs. The front of the table features three oval-shaped decorative inlays with a gold or yellow leaf motif on a black or dark background, placed in the center and at each end. There is also a gold or yellow trim running horizontally along the bottom edge of the tabletop and around the inlays. To the left of the table, there is a vertical rectangular inset with detailed line drawings: an enlarged version of the oval decorative motif at the top, followed by ornamental designs and a straight line running downward. The drawing is on a light beige or off-white background, with minimal shading or additional objects present. The lower right corner has small printed or handwritten text: “SERIES A – 7 #15.”
title: Card Table
